what_it_does: Introduces Vernier, a monitoring system for observing how large-scale scientific computing applications send data across computer networks. Current tools either collect too little information (aggregated statistics) or too much (exhaustive traces), both causing scalability problems. Vernier uses histogram-based sampling of communication patterns to capture meaningful detail without overwhelming the system. It enables offline analysis, performance benchmarking, and network simulation. Targets understanding irregular and dynamic communication behavior in supercomputing workloads.
